name: stage
description: Route STAGE requests to the project's academic-writing workflow skills.

interface.shortDescription: Route a request to one STAGE writing workflow.
interface.longDescription: Adds the $stage router for choosing and running one STAGE academic-writing workflow skill in the current project, and $stage-auto for pursuing a stated paper goal across the unmarked skills, stopping at any explicit-only one.
defaultPrompt: Use $stage to show the current paper status.
